title: Cosateca / Tool Library
subtitle: Community library of shared objects and tools
no_objects: No objects registered in this node's tool library.
name: Name
design_ref_help: Reference to a certified design in the OAD repository (Open Access Design): blueprints, bill of materials, maintenance protocol.
tq_value_help: Embodied energy of the object in TQ (1 TQ = 1 kWh), per the node's energy catalog.
contributions_help: A tool library is not just an object inventory: three distinct layers — the physical object, the record of its use, and reciprocity recognized by the community.
principle_object_desc: The physical tool that exists and must be preserved: status, location, OAD design reference, and embodied value in TQ.
principle_record_desc: Availability, loans (who uses it, until when), and maintenance history. No one needs to own everything they use.
principle_reciprocity_desc: Whoever contributes an object to the community pool receives TQ recognition, valued by the node's assembly. Loans and use follow rules approved by each eco-village.
